approvals.scope: Every Phase 1 package and tool in this file (plan 01-01 Task 1, package legitimacy gate), approved before the first restore

Version-pinned license exceptions (plan 01-11 Task 2) for two transitive runtime packages that the SQL Server driver brings along: Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SNI.runtime 6.0.2 (Microsoft Software License Terms - Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SNI Library) and Microsoft.Identity.Client.NativeInterop 0.20.6 (Microsoft Software License Terms). Free of charge, not open source, shipped unmodified inside the app only, with Microsoft's notices kept. Only these exact versions are exempt; the machine-readable list is docs/license-exceptions.json and the license gate is tools/scripts/New-ThirdPartyNotices.ps1.

nuqs 2.10.1 (MIT) with its one dependency @standard-schema/spec 1.1.0 (MIT), planned for Phase 2 Web Foundation to keep list-page state in the URL query string (quick task 261007-kz6, requirement WEB-10). Approved after a check for npm security advisories, deprecation and the 14-day cool-down. Not installed yet, so it is recorded under planned. Switching to any other version, for example a stable 2.10.2 at least 14 days old, needs a new owner approval at install.

Transitive cool-down exception for web/: source-map-js 1.2.2 (BSD-3-Clause, build/test only; pulled in by Vite, PostCSS and the coverage tools). Pinned exactly through overrides in web/package.json and excluded from min-release-age in web/.npmrc. Published 2026-09-30, so younger than 14 days at install. Package entry: web/source-map-js in packages (moved from this approval in plan 02-03, when the registry check learned the npm kind).

Transitive cool-down exception for web/: http-cache-semantics 4.3.0 (BSD-2-Clause, tool only; pulled in only by license-checker-rseidelsohn -> @npmcli/arborist -> make-fetch-happen). Pinned exactly through overrides in web/package.json and excluded from min-release-age in web/.npmrc. Published 2026-10-04, so younger than 14 days at install. Package entry: web/http-cache-semantics in packages (moved from this approval in plan 02-03, when the registry check learned the npm kind).

Transitive cool-down waiver for web/: rolldown 1.2.11 (MIT, build only), the bundler engine inside vite 8.3.3 (vite asks for ~1.2.11), together with its 15 matching @rolldown/binding-* 1.2.11 platform packages (MIT). Published 2026-09-24T14:30Z, 11.5 hours short of 14 days at install. Pinned exactly to 1.2.11 through overrides in web/package.json and excluded from min-release-age in web/.npmrc; without the pin npm picks 1.2.13 (published 2026-10-07), which is not approved. Any other rolldown version needs a new owner approval. Package entry: web/rolldown and web/@rolldown/binding-* in packages (moved from this approval in plan 02-03, when the registry check learned the npm kind).

D-25: the full Phase 2 "Packages Requiring Owner Approval" table in .planning/phases/02-web-foundation-design-system/02-RESEARCH.md as recommended, at the exact versions listed there (every web/* and tools/openapi-gen/* direct pin in packages). Includes vite 8.3.3 as a security-fix cool-down exception (GHSA-rq7h-c2jc-7f22, GHSA-vfpm-58rq-9qcg, GHSA-9jrq-w75r-8gcw fixed in 8.3.3), lighthouse 13.5.0 with an in-house assert script replacing @lhci/cli (11 high-severity audit findings), MSW deferred to the first phase with real endpoints, and neither optional package (@tanstack/eslint-plugin-query, rollup-plugin-visualizer) adopted.

D-11: lucide-react follows the newest stable release at install time (1.52.0 on 2026-10-07); the 14-day cool-down is waived for lucide-react only, after an advisory, deprecation and regression check of that exact version. Recorded on web/lucide-react and in web/.npmrc.

D-26: license exceptions for the npm dev/build tree only, never the shipped (production) tree: MPL-2.0 widened from test to build (lightningcss in Vite 8 and Tailwind 4), CC-BY-4.0 (caniuse-lite), CC0-1.0 (language-subtag-registry), BlueOak-1.0.0 (minimatch) and 0BSD (tslib). All free. The machine-readable list is npmLicenseExceptions in docs/license-exceptions.json, gated by web/scripts/license-gate.mjs; the MPL-2.0 build scope is also in policy.exceptions here.
